entries.note: The order's registration, before the warehouse has the parcel.
iMile's order record, copied a second after the registration.
The Shenzhen warehouse takes the parcel in. iMile's feed writes the row again without its code at the same clock; that copy goes.
The parcel leaves the Shenzhen warehouse.

entries.wording: Your order has been shipped from 【…】.
entries.note: iMile's departure from a warehouse, centre or station, copied; its name is read as an ellipsis.
Export clearance at Hong Kong, written by hand on the whole hour.

entries.wording: Arrived at the port of departure
entries.note: Hong Kong's airport, written by hand on the whole hour.
The flight leaves Hong Kong; the line gives its day alone.
The flight lands in Mexico City; the line gives its day alone.
Mexican import clearance begins; the line gives its day alone.
Mexican import clearance is done; the line gives its day alone.
iMile's hub in Mexico City receives the parcel, copied; its name is read as an ellipsis.
An iMile station in Mexico City, copied.
An iMile centre or delivery station, copied.
iMile's courier could not reach the recipient, between two rounds, copied.
iMile's abnormal scan at its Mexico City centre, five weeks after the parcel's last movement there and with no delivery round; the record's status then says the forwarder paid compensation (已赔付).
